quality_notes: Curious Refuge Labs score 7.49/10 (Prompt Adherence 8.0, Temporal Consistency 6.3, Visual Fidelity 8.1, Motion Quality 7.3, Style & Cinematic Realism 7.1). Prompt adherence strong with concrete shot grammar (camera framing/lens/motion verbs) but weak on emotion/subtext; leading with emotion causes early drift. Temporal consistency improved over earlier models: flicker and "2D dropout" artifacts fell by more than half, though a few frames flatten/lose parallax around blinks, and fast-velocity motion (e.g. shadow boxing) collapses into jumbled/duplicated arms. Visual fidelity is the strongest category: convincing environmental detail, fabric/metal/countertop textures, realistic lighting and depth of field; explosion VFX clips midtowns (halo at peak brightness) and debris resolves as clumps rather than particulate. Motion is stable and geometry-conscious but rarely changes velocity—smooth, mechanically controlled camera moves with little weight or spontaneity. Cinematic realism feels staged and controlled (no handheld imperfection); crowds/explosions expand too cleanly without chaos. Overall: technically filmic and visually coherent, ideal for control-focused production workflows, but not spontaneous or "human."
notes: Specs: up to 10 seconds of video, 1080p, 24 FPS, accessible through third-party platforms, offers a 'Fast' version. Rated 7.49/10 overall by Curious Refuge Labs across an 18-shot test suite. Review is stated as non-biased and not affiliated with Hailuo Minimax. Recommended for AI video artists; available via third-party tool aggregators.
